newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BES stock jumps on Q1 results. [CORRECTED 17:17 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BES stock jumps on Q1 results. [CORRECTED 17:17 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Banco Espirito Santo rose sharply after the bank issued better than expected first quarter results showing a 45 percent jump in consolidated profit.
The share was up 1.46 percent at 3,399 escudos with traders saying that there was good support around 3,400 (Corrects from 3,400 being resistance point).
"Profit was higher than the highest forecasts which were pointing at 6.5 billion escudos," said one dealer. The bank posted a consolidated profit of 6.9 billion.
"The profit figure is very good and there is good growth in deposits and loans," added another trader.
